title: Prohibition on Transfer of Research Results Without Prior NBA Approval
content:
Section 4 provides that no person shall, without previous approval of the National Biodiversity Authority, transfer the results of any research relating to any biological resources occurring in, or obtained from, India, to any person who is not a citizen of India or is a foreign body corporate.

Key Relevance for Ayurvedic R&D:
1. Collaborative research: Indian academic institutions or AYUSH startups collaborating with foreign pharmaceutical companies or universities must obtain NBA Form II approval before sharing extracts, formulation data, or bioassay results.
2. Publication exemption: Publication of research papers in journals or seminars is exempted only if complying with Central Government guidelines.
